item.title: Wisp Beta 1.5.2
item.description:
• Talk to Wisp. Hold ⌃⌥Space, say what you want, and let go. It uses your Mac’s own speech recognition, free and on your Mac.
  • Follow-up questions. Ask “explain that simpler” or “give me an example” right under any answer, by typing or talking.
  • Flashcards mode. Turn any notes or page into flashcards you can flip through, then copy them to Quizlet or save them for Anki.
